input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position. § 24.1 gives us a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor (notice only); § 24.2 binds Vendor to our prior written consent (reasonableness standard) for assignment, delegation of material performance or transfer by change of control, and bars assignment to a direct competitor; § 24.3's residual consent requirement is expressly limited to "other assignments" and so does not swallow the § 24.1 carve-out; and § 24.4 confirms our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service. § 13.3 tracks Section 24 by allowing licence transfer to an Affiliate or permitted successor. No change-of-control or assignment trigger for Vendor termination appears elsewhere (§ 9.2 is insolvency-only). No redline needed.
